title: When Faith Outruns Fear
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delivers a powerful message of faith and perseverance in the face of spiritual attack. In this sermon, Pastor Chris shares a personal testimony of being under attack with a life-threatening condition, but refusing to back down, and instead standing on God's promises to bring healing and deliverance. Hear how Pastor Chris's bold faith in the midst of adversity sparked a miracle that will leave you encouraged and challenged to trust God in your own battles.
